blocks.text: DR-TB is a laboratory diagnosis confirmed after culturing Mycobacterium tuberculosis strains and performing drug susceptibility tests (DST). WHO recommends the use of rapid genotypic tests such as Xpert MTB/RIF and TrueNat as initial diagnostic tests for TB as well as RR/MDR-TB cases that are eligible for MDR-TB treatment.

The use of corticosteroids in DR-TB patients can be beneficial in cases of severe respiratory insufficiency and severe extrapulmonary involvement. Prednisolone should be given in case by case at a starting dose of approximately 1mg/kg, (Maximum 80mg per day) with a gradual decrease in the daily dose by 10mg per week when a longer course is indicated.
